'''"Mad Akk" Geden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] who was a former [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] and a member of the [[Terror Brigade]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who exhibited powers such as [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], Geden fought with a melee weapon in battle, and was defeated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces as part of the [[Onslaught (Terror Brigade)|Onslaught]] challenges held by the Terror Brigade on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="TOR:TTB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geden appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an enemy in the Heroic mission "The Terror Brigade" on Hoth for Republic players.<ref name="TOR:TTB" />
